threats.name: Unauthorized Memory Write
threats.scenario: Model or user-controlled state is written into persistent memory without explicit authorization.
threats.impact: Untrusted content gains durable influence over future behavior.

threats.name: Persistent Instruction Poisoning
threats.scenario: Malicious natural-language instructions are stored in persistent AI memory.
threats.impact: Prompt compromise may persist beyond the originating session.

threats.name: RAG-to-Memory Poisoning
threats.scenario: Poisoned retrieved content is persisted into long-lived memory.
threats.impact: Retrieval compromise becomes persistent AI state.

threats.name: Prompt-to-Memory Poisoning
threats.scenario: Adversarial user prompt content is accepted into persistent memory.
threats.impact: Attacker-controlled state may influence future sessions.

threats.name: Memory Authorization Bypass
threats.scenario: Memory persistence occurs despite missing, invalid, or denied authorization.
threats.impact: Fail-open persistence allows unauthorized durable state.

threats.name: Model-Generated Memory Approval
threats.scenario: Model output claims that a memory write is approved and the system accepts the claim.
threats.impact: Generated text may become false authorization evidence.

threats.name: Persistent Memory Record Tampering
threats.scenario: Stored memory records are modified without authorization.
threats.impact: Future model behavior may be influenced by corrupted state.

threats.name: Unauthorized Memory Record Insertion
threats.scenario: Attacker inserts new memory records directly into the store.
threats.impact: False or malicious state becomes persistent.

threats.name: Memory Record Deletion
threats.scenario: Trusted persistent memory is deleted or selectively removed.
threats.impact: Integrity and continuity of trusted AI state may be lost.

threats.name: Sensitive Data Persistence
threats.scenario: Sensitive prompt, RAG, identity, credential, or business information is stored unnecessarily.
threats.impact: Confidential data may persist beyond intended processing.

threats.name: Cross-User Memory Disclosure
threats.scenario: Memory from one user is returned to another user.
threats.impact: Confidential cross-user information may be exposed.

threats.name: Cross-Tenant Memory Disclosure
threats.scenario: Persistent state from one tenant is retrieved in another tenant context.
threats.impact: Tenant isolation may fail.

threats.name: Cross-Session Poison Activation
threats.scenario: Malicious state written in one session is retrieved during a later session.
threats.impact: Attack persistence survives the original interaction.

threats.name: Cross-Agent Memory Propagation
threats.scenario: Memory written by one agent influences another agent operating under a different trust context.
threats.impact: Compromise may spread across autonomous components.

threats.name: Stale Trust Reuse
threats.scenario: Old memory retains a trust classification that is no longer valid.
threats.impact: Previously trusted state may be reused after its authority expires.

threats.name: Missing Memory Provenance
threats.scenario: Stored memory lacks reliable source, session, agent, timestamp, or authorization metadata.
threats.impact: The application cannot distinguish trusted memory from untrusted state.

threats.name: Memory Provenance Tampering
threats.scenario: Metadata is altered to make malicious memory appear trusted.
threats.impact: Compromised state may inherit false authority.

threats.name: Memory Expiration Failure
threats.scenario: Memory remains active after expiry or revocation.
threats.impact: Unsafe or obsolete state may continue influencing decisions.

threats.name: Memory-to-Agent Goal Hijacking
threats.scenario: Retrieved memory modifies the agent objective, workflow, tool, or target.
threats.impact: Persistent state can redirect downstream agent behavior.

threats.name: Memory-to-Privileged Tool Escalation
threats.scenario: Persistent memory influences the agent or tool router to select a privileged capability.
threats.impact: Stored malicious state may approach privileged execution.

threats.name: Memory-Based Target Substitution
threats.scenario: Stored memory replaces the trusted target with a restricted or attacker-selected target.
threats.impact: Legitimate workflows may be redirected toward high-impact assets.

threats.name: Memory-Generated Authorization Claim
threats.scenario: Persistent memory claims approval or authorization for a sensitive action.
threats.impact: Stored natural-language state may be mistaken for execution authority.

threats.name: Memory Exhaustion
threats.scenario: Excessive or adversarial writes consume storage, indexing, retrieval, or context capacity.
threats.impact: Memory availability, cost, latency, or retrieval quality may degrade.

threats.name: Memory Retrieval Amplification
threats.scenario: Adversarial state triggers excessively broad or repeated memory retrieval.
threats.impact: Model context and system resources may be exhausted.

threats.name: Memory Telemetry Suppression
threats.scenario: Memory reads, writes, provenance, authorization, or cross-session retrievals are not logged.
threats.impact: Persistent compromise becomes difficult to detect or reconstruct.

threats.name: Memory Forensic Tampering
threats.scenario: Security events describing malicious memory activity are modified or deleted.
threats.impact: Investigation and attribution may be impaired.

abuse_chains.name: Prompt Poisoning to Persistent Compromise
abuse_chains.impact: Prompt-controlled state persists into future sessions.

abuse_chains.name: RAG Poisoning to Cross-Agent Propagation
abuse_chains.impact: Poisoned retrieval becomes persistent and influences another agent.

abuse_chains.name: Memory Poisoning to Privileged Execution
abuse_chains.impact: Persistent malicious state approaches privileged execution authority.

abuse_chains.name: Provenance Tampering to Trusted-State Abuse
abuse_chains.impact: Malicious memory is made to appear trusted and influences agent behavior.

abuse_chains.name: Cross-Tenant Memory to Sensitive Disclosure
abuse_chains.impact: Persistent state exposes confidential information across trust boundaries.
